name: Squid
description: Weapon mod: your bullets are squid that swim at enemies, latch on and gnaw them, healing you. Mash jump or block to shake them off.
details: Each squid swims at the nearest enemy it can see in pulses (top speed 13 m/s, much slower on average, so you can outrun them). When it reaches someone it latches on and bites every 0.45 s for 24% of its damage (with all your bullet effects), for up to 3.6 s, healing you for 25% of each bite on top of your +10% lifesteal. The victim can block (1.2 s stun) or mash jump 4 times in 1.2 s (2.2 s stun for every squid on them) to knock them off; a stunned squid drifts, then hunts again. Squid can't bite through shields or a block, and a blocked squid turns on whoever blocked it.
